title: Model structures on over categories
statement: Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category with the cofibration, fibration and weak-equivalence terminology of [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction], and let $B\in\mathcal M$. The category $\mathcal M/B$ has objects morphisms $X\to B$ and morphisms commuting triangles. It has a model structure in which a morphism is a cofibration, fibration or weak equivalence respectively if and only if its underlying morphism in $\mathcal M$ is. No fibrancy assumption on $B$ is required.
